definitions.explanation: The Christian cross or crucifix as a religious symbol. Also refers to the physical object.
Used figuratively to mean a heavy burden or responsibility that one must endure.

examples.japanese: ⟦{教会|きょうかい}→教会：01387_kyoukai⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{上|うえ}→上：00682_ue⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{十字架|じゅうじか}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦ある→ある：00006_aru⟧。
examples.english: There is a cross on top of the church.

examples.japanese: ⟦{首|くび}→首：00792_kubi⟧⟦から→から：00504_kara⟧{十字架|じゅうじか}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦ネックレス→ネックレス：04539_nekkuresu⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{下|さ}げている→下げる：00807_sageru⟧。
examples.english: She is wearing a cross necklace around her neck.

examples.japanese: ⟦キリスト→キリスト：24422_kirisuto⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{十字架|じゅうじか}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧かけられた⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦{伝|つた}えられている→伝える：01220_tsutaeru⟧。
examples.english: It is said that Christ was crucified on the cross.

examples.japanese: ⟦その→その：00993_sono⟧⟦{過去|かこ}→過去：00152_kako⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{彼|かれ}→彼：01292_kare⟧⟦にとって→にとって：06803_nitotte⟧⟦{重|おも}い→重い：00804_omoi⟧{十字架|じゅうじか}だ。
examples.english: That past is a heavy cross for him to bear.

examples.japanese: ⟦あの→あの：00915_ano⟧⟦{事故|じこ}→事故：00851_jiko⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{一生|いっしょう}→一生：01728_isshou⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{十字架|じゅうじか}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦なる→なる：01970_naru⟧だろう。
examples.english: That accident will be a cross to bear for a lifetime.

notes:
USAGE:
Sense 1 is the literal religious object. Sense 2 is a figurative extension meaning a heavy burden or guilt, similar to the English expression "cross to bear." The figurative use is common in literary and dramatic contexts.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {十字架|じゅうじか}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{背負|せお}う→背負う：16159_seou⟧ (to bear a cross; to carry a burden)
- {十字架|じゅうじか}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦かける→かける：00854_kakeru⟧ (to crucify)
- {十字架|じゅうじか}⟦{像|ぞう}→像：03691_zou⟧ (crucifix statue)
